description: This source file contains implementation of text parsing classes `TextParser` and `PathParser` within the namespace `WPEFramework::Core`. The `TextParser` class provides methods for reading text segments delimited by specific characters, and the `PathParser` class parses filesystem paths into drive, directory, filename, extension, and base filename components.

classes.name: TextParser
classes.description: A class for parsing text segments from a string, supporting operations like reading text up to delimiters, skipping characters, and finding substring positions.

classes.name: PathParser
classes.description: A class that parses filesystem path strings into drive, path, filename, extension, and base filename components.

methods.name: uint32_t ReadText(const TCHAR delimiters[],const uint32_t offset) const
methods.description: Reads a segment of text from the current position up to a specified delimiter or quote character if the path starts with a quote.

methods.name: ReadText (overload)
methods.description: Reads a text segment into an OptionalType<TextFragment>, handling delimiters and updating the parser position accordingly.

methods.name: void Parse(const TextFragment & input)
methods.description: Parses a given path string into its drive letter, directory path, filename, extension, and base filename components.

ctags.name: ReadText
ctags.pattern: /^    uint32_t TextParser::ReadText(const TCHAR delimiters[], const uint32_t offset) const$/
